attrs.quote: The language version for a Go version is the result of truncating everything after the N: 1.21, 1.21rc2, and 1.21.3 all implement language version 1.21.
attrs.note: Absent: the pages checked (https://go.dev/doc/toolchain, https://go.dev/doc/go1compat) describe no edition mechanism; the language version above is the nearest statement.
